fact: The Central Bank of Tunisia's Circular to Banks No. 2025-06 of 28 February 2025 requires banks doing electronic client onboarding to verify identity documents against the issuing authorities' electronic systems where connected and to match biometric data, at a level at least equal to physical presence.
title: Circular to Banks No. 2025-06 of February 28, 2025
why_not: off-topic: a central bank onboarding circular, not a rule made under the identity law
